page.overview:
What is 27 Charles Street?

27 Charles Street belongs to Halloween. The Cole residence is the household of the Cole family, consisting of: Daniel Cole, Diana Cole and Craig Cole.

Sometime around October 23, 2000, the Cole home was broken into by Michael Myers, who murdered Craig and his wife Diana Cole. Myers also murdered their six-year-old son Daniel and placed a toy clown in his lap.

He then placed the corpses sitting in front of the TV.
